entities.name: Constellari
entities.description: An imagined race of nonhuman prophets, hailed as saints for their accurate predictions, who codified their visions into the Codex.

entities.name: Codex
entities.description: The book into which the Constellari codified their visions, lifting the world out of a time of shadow.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A spirit dragon with invisible breath and an 'eye', known only through Future Sight flavor text.

entities.name: Overmother
entities.description: An ominous being with an incompletely human-like anatomy, to whom devoted prayers are uttered.

entities.name: Dweldian magi
entities.description: Mages who avoid the Realm of Thrones afterlife by being sucked into elementals of storm.

entities.name: Realm of Thrones
entities.description: A strange afterlife that the Dweldian magi avoid.

entities.name: Xathrid
entities.description: An unexplained name tied to Xathrid Demon and Acolyte of Xathrid, which bring pain to the living.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The grim post-apocalyptic setting of the Future Sight block.

events.summary: In the author's imagined account, the Constellari come and codify their visions into the Codex, lifting the world out of shadow, ending bitter war and bringing good harvests.
events.quote: When the Constellari came and codified their visions into the Codex, they lifted the world out of a time of shadow, bringing good harvests and an end to bitter war.

events.summary: The people hail the Constellari as saints and give them authority as year counters, grain blessers and prayer poets.
events.quote: The people hailed the Constellari as saints, and trusted their utterances as law

events.summary: Skeptics begin to question the Constellari and find chinks in their perfect truth.
events.quote: And some found chinks in their wall of perfect truth.

relations.note: They codified their visions into it.
relations.quote: When the Constellari came and codified their visions into the Codex
